name: Wake Up SQUID — Mate
source: KB: squid-on-board-binder / §5 Mate Boat Checklist — WAKING SQUID UP
intro: Morning mate checklist. Date and Thyme opens at 8am.

items.label: Check rack cards on sign posts (SQUID and Cowfish)
Clean as necessary (overnight mess, missed spots, leaf litter)
Remove cushions from head (or take down from hang drying) and place on benches
TP and hand soap in head, backup TP in mate's cabinet (single ply — won't clog)
Check daily required maintenance task and complete if possible
Dry any dew in the guest area with a shammy
How many guests expected? Enough water and provisions?

help.title: Provisions check
help.body: Confirm guest count from rez software. Make sure there is plenty of water (especially in summer), organic fruits/veggies from Date and Thyme, and enough snorkel gear for the number of kids and adults.

items.label: Prepare sanitizer buckets for snorkel gear
Set up the lifejacket table with props

completion.notes_prompt: Any supplies running low? Anything to flag for the captain?
